title: Vedic Tricks, Explained
summary: Learn four famous shortcuts from Vedic mathematics, and the algebra that makes each one work: "all from $9$ and the last from $10$" for subtracting from $1000$, multiplying near a base of $10$ or $100$, "vertically and crosswise" for two-digit products, and bases like $50$.
bigIdeas: A trick is only useful if you know when it works, and why.
Every shortcut here is an ordinary algebra identity in disguise.
tips: $1000 - 368$: take each digit from $9$, the last from $10$: $632$.
Same tens, ones add to $10$: $43 \times 47$: $4 \times 5 = 20$, $3 \times 7 = 21$, so $2021$.
